responses.text: I don't speak with outsiders, smoothskins especially. Talk to our leader, Jason Bright.
Sorry, we don't talk to outsiders. Talk to Jason if you have business here.
Jason will lead us to the Far Beyond!
Jason will deliver us from the pain of this world!
All praise the Great Journey! All praise the creator's divine will!
The holy fire will carry us to our salvation!
Thank you for taking care of the demons, smoothskin.
Now that the demons are gone, we can finally begin our final steps.
The demons are really gone? Bright shines!
We will never reach the Far Beyond.
The Great Journey will never happen.
What have you done? Bright was the best of us.
I knew you weren't to be trusted!
